run_cifar100_models: run a CIFAR100 models experiment with resnet50 architecture and autoaugment plus cutout augmentation from scratch
run_cifar100_baseline: run a CIFAR100 baseline fine-tuning experiment in normal mode with 50 epochs and reinitialized logits
run_cifar100_conformal_training: run a CIFAR100 conformal training sub-experiment with threshold_logp method and normal size loss
run_cifar100_hierarchy_size: run a CIFAR100 conformal hierarchy_size sub-experiment sweeping size_weights for a selected hierarchy group
run_cifar100_group_zero: run a CIFAR100 conformal group_zero sub-experiment sweeping loss_matrix values for group zero classes
